description: This file provides Windows-specific file information functions, including retrieving and setting file times, attributes, standard info, and file ID, using Windows API calls.

methods.name: GetFileBasicInfo
methods.description: Retrieves file times and attributes for a given file handle.

methods.name: SetFileBasicInfo
methods.description: Sets file times and attributes for a given file handle.

methods.name: GetFileStandardInfo
methods.description: Retrieves extended standard information for a file.

methods.name: GetFileID
methods.description: Retrieves the unique volume serial number and file ID for a file.
